$comment: The output contract of every Risk Analysis report (#692, owner 2026-10-15: "important that we dont chg names as fx integrations, connectors will break"). A report's output columns may be ADDED to, never renamed or removed. Adding a column: add it here in the same change. Removing or renaming one needs the owner's word and a migration for every connector.
outputsComment: #692 the connector output maps (data-model/outputs/<id>.locked.json): every column a connector receives (its target name), pinned the same way -- ServiceNow, the SQL hand-off and the Excel exports read these names. Additions only.
structureExceptionsComment: #692 (e) the query reports that do not yet have every part of the standard structure (ops/report-certification/SI-ReportStructure.ps1), each with the part missing.
